cmd: cd /workspaces/bcuz && go build -o bin/bcuz ./cmd/bcuz && cd "$TMPDIR" && { /workspaces/bcuz/bin/bcuz --completion powershell; printf "%s\n" "\"### 0\"" "\$line = 'bcuz -'" "(TabExpansion2 \$line \$line.Length).CompletionMatches | ForEach-Object { \$_.CompletionText }"; } | TERM=dumb pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command - 2>&1 | sed "s/\x1b\[[?0-9;]*[a-zA-Z]//g" | tail -20

why: 標準入力の pwsh で、どこから先が動かなくなるかを切り分ける
cmd: cd "$TMPDIR"; echo "--- A: plain"; printf "%s\n" "\"hi\"" | TERM=dumb pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command - 2>&1 | sed "s/\x1b\[[?0-9;]*[a-zA-Z]//g"; echo "--- B: header comments then hi"; { /workspaces/bcuz/bin/bcuz --completion powershell | head -10; echo "\"hi\""; } | TERM=dumb pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command - 2>&1 | sed "s/\x1b\[[?0-9;]*[a-zA-Z]//g"; echo "--- C: whole script then hi"; { /workspaces/bcuz/bin/bcuz --completion powershell; echo "\"hi\""; } | TERM=dumb pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command - 2>&1 | sed "s/\x1b\[[?0-9;]*[a-zA-Z]//g"

why: 比べるため、mtqg のスクリプトなら標準入力の pwsh で後ろが動くかを見る
cmd: { mtqg completion powershell; echo "\"hi\""; } | TERM=dumb pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command - 2>&1 | sed "s/\x1b\[[?0-9;]*[a-zA-Z]//g"; echo "--- pwsh errors for bcuz script"; /workspaces/bcuz/bin/bcuz --completion powershell > "$TMPDIR/c.ps1"; TERM=dumb pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "\$t=\$null;\$e=\$null;[void][System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile(\"$TMPDIR/c.ps1\",[ref]\$t,[ref]\$e); \$e | ForEach-Object { \$_.ToString() }"

why: テストの空行を直したので、PowerShell を含む補完テストが通るか確かめる
PowerShell が -- の行をどんな要素に分けるかを確かめる
cmd: cd "$TMPDIR" && printf "%s\n" "\$ast = [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseInput(\"bcuz -- -x bcuzfakecmd \", [ref]\$null, [ref]\$null)" "\$ast.EndBlock.Statements[0].PipelineElements[0].CommandElements | ForEach-Object { \"{0} [{1}] {2}-{3}\" -f \$_.GetType().Name, \$_.Extent.Text, \$_.Extent.StartOffset, \$_.Extent.EndOffset }" "\$ast = [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseInput(\"bcuz why bcuzfakecmd \", [ref]\$null, [ref]\$null)" "\$ast.EndBlock.Statements[0].PipelineElements[0].CommandElements | ForEach-Object { \"{0} [{1}] {2}-{3}\" -f \$_.GetType().Name, \$_.Extent.Text, \$_.Extent.StartOffset, \$_.Extent.EndOffset }" > p.ps1 && pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -File p.ps1

why: CompleteInput に空の語で渡したとき、偽のコマンドの補完が呼ばれるかを確かめる
cmd: cd "$TMPDIR" && /workspaces/bcuz/bin/bcuz --completion powershell > c.ps1 && printf "%s\n" ". ./c.ps1" "Register-ArgumentCompleter -Native -CommandName bcuzfakecmd -ScriptBlock { param(\$word) \"alpha\",\"beta\" | ForEach-Object { [System.Management.Automation.CompletionResult]::new(\$_, \$_, \"ParameterValue\", \$_) } }" "\"--- direct\"" "[System.Management.Automation.CommandCompletion]::CompleteInput(\"bcuzfakecmd \", 12, \$null).CompletionMatches.CompletionText" "\"--- why with space\"" "(TabExpansion2 \"bcuz why bcuzfakecmd \" 21).CompletionMatches.CompletionText" "\"--- dashdash with space\"" "(TabExpansion2 \"bcuz -- -x bcuzfakecmd \" 23).CompletionMatches.CompletionText" "\"--- dashdash a\"" "(TabExpansion2 \"bcuz -- -x bcuzfakecmd a\" 24).CompletionMatches.CompletionText" > d.ps1 && pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -File d.ps1
